request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT

layers.text: Change only the colours: the red paper rocket tube becomes black tarred cardboard painted with hazard yellow and black diagonal stripes along its whole length; the fuse spark becomes red-orange; the little goblin wears near-black dark brown leather. Keep the cream cone cap, cream bands, stick, fuse, the dark iron cart, the wheels, the rocket shape and angle, the crouching goblin, his olive skin, proportions, thick black outline and art style exactly the same.
